content: Each statement carries one character class the vendored fonts cover; the harness asserts verbatim survival (srCharFidelity). Prose fields also carry contract-v2 constructs: inline math $x^2 + sqrt(y_i) / 2$ and $Delta v <= 0.5$, a literal \$500 dollar, *emphasis*, and a [link](https://example.com). Contract-v2 expressiveness: a dollar in code `$PATH` needs no escape, escaped angle brackets \<config\> render literally, and math coexists: $sqrt(2)$.

requirements.statement: Latin extended: naïve façade Größe œuvre señor Ångström çedilla
Greek and Cyrillic: αβγδ ΩΘΣ Кириллица тест
Typst markup as literal text: #emph[x] *bold* _under_ @ref <label> $integral$ // comment
Quotes and punctuation: «guillemets» „low" – dash — emdash … ellipsis 'curly' "double"
Currency: € euro £ pound ¥ yen ₹ rupee ¢ cent
Combining and compatibility: é (decomposed é), ﬁ ligature char, ½ ¼ fractions, ⁰¹² superscripts
Arrows and symbols: A → B, X ⇒ Y, warn ⚠, ballot ☑
Emoji (monochrome by D0236): 🚀 ✅ and enclosed ①②③
requirements.rationale: These classes were refused before D0236 vendored the Noto fallbacks; math renders here too: $E = m c^2$.

requirements.statement: Kern-heavy id class one: extraction must survive the T-hyphen kern pair.
Kern-heavy id class two: V-hyphen kerning.
Operating range 10–20 Hz uses an en-dash, which some extractors map to the replacement character.
